_comment: Example ck:quality receipt. Issued only by scripts/receipt.py issue, only for a report whose verdict is APPROVED with zero open blocking findings. Verified by scripts/receipt.py verify and by hooks/quality_receipt_gate.py. Not a JSON-Schema document — an annotated canonical instance, matching this pack's plan-schema.json convention.
_target: The phase file stem this receipt clears for completion — e.g. the stem of phase-02-receipt-gate.md or phase-02-receipt-gate.json. Matches report.target from the report it was issued from.
_verdict: Always APPROVED. A CHANGES_REQUIRED report never produces a receipt.
_policy_version: Must equal scripts/receipt.py POLICY_VERSION at verify time. A version mismatch invalidates the receipt even if the fingerprint still matches — it forces re-verification under the current contract after a policy change.
_report_path: Repo-relative path to the exact report this receipt was derived from.
_reviewed_files: Copied verbatim from report.reviewed_files, sorted. Every entry must resolve inside the repository.
_source_fingerprint: sha256 over the report file's exact bytes plus every reviewed file's exact current bytes, in sorted path order. Any change to the report or to a reviewed file after issuance invalidates this hash.
_reviewed_at: Copied from report.reviewed_at — informational only, not part of the trust check.
_open_blocking_findings: Always 0. Recomputed independently from report.findings at issue time (OPEN + BLOCKER/HIGH, or OPEN + MEDIUM with introduced_by_current_change true) rather than trusted from report.summary.
_verification_rule: A receipt is VALID only when: its filename is {target}-receipt.json; target matches both the guarded phase and report.target; verdict is APPROVED; policy_version matches current; open_blocking_findings is 0; report_path and every reviewed_files entry resolve inside the repo and still exist on disk; and recomputing source_fingerprint from current disk contents produces an identical hash. Any other outcome is INVALID and the completion transition it guards must be blocked.
_scope_disclaimer: A valid receipt proves the reviewed report and reviewed files are byte-identical to what an APPROVED verdict was issued against. It does not itself prove the semantic review (SOLID, ownership, architecture) was correct — that judgment lives in the report the receipt points to.
